school.school_name: 東京アニメ・声優＆eスポーツ専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the current Tokyo Anime public-info page where an old support PDF link is commented out and the visible target-form PDF still lacks explicit FY2026 evidence.
search_queries: 東京アニメ・声優＆eスポーツ専門学校 確認申請書 様式第2号
steps: Confirm that the old 07_study_support_application.pdf link is inside an HTML comment and should not be treated as a visible candidate.
Find the visible link labeled 確認申請書様式 and resolve it to pdf/11_confirmation_application.pdf.
Inspect the PDF text and confirm it is target-shaped, but the URL, visible anchor, and PDF body do not prove FY2026.
Classify it as needs_operator_review instead of strict accepted_target_pdf.

reusable_rules: Ignore PDF links inside HTML comments because they are not operator-visible publication links.
Keep visible 確認申請書 anchors as target-form candidates even when no target-year evidence exists.
Route target-shaped PDFs with no FY2026 evidence to needs_operator_review with the direct PDF URL preserved.
anti_patterns: Do not resurrect a commented-out PDF link as the latest publication candidate.
Do not infer FY2026 from a current information-disclosure page alone.
Do not count officer-term or committee-term years in the PDF body as target fiscal-year evidence.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found 07_study_support_application.pdf only inside an HTML comment. The visible 11_confirmation_application.pdf is target-shaped but has no URL, anchor, or PDF-body FY2026 evidence.
